visual_director.decision: Proceed with monitored revenue recovery while closing the South retention gap.
visual_director.truth: Revenue totals 551 across North/South/West; South retention is 92.8% against a 95% target; Q1–Q4 retention rises from 91.8% to 94.6%.
visual_director.character: Executive decision brief with a single headline, short context, regional evidence table, retention trend, risk callout and next step.
visual_director.negative_identity: Not a general-purpose dashboard or a pile of KPI cards.
visual_director.density: Moderate; three regional rows and a four-quarter series support the decision.
visual_director.salience: Decision headline first; regional comparison and trend second; action/risk after supporting evidence.
visual_director.typography: Large report headline; small subordinate context; compact table headers/body; chart title/axes; emphatic KPI values; body copy for rationale.
visual_director.spacing: Opening headline/context share a band; evidence and analysis have separate section gaps; support metrics form one group; decision and next step close the document.
visual_director.surfaces: Light report canvas; table, risk callout and KPI containers separate content groups.
visual_director.feature_support: Headline and regional table lead; trend confirms; risk and next-step provide action.
visual_director.color: Blue is neutral data/table accent; red text marks risk; green status marks review.
visual_director.data_density: Three region rows; four ordered quarters; no small-multiple grid.
visual_director.responsive: One-column ordered report at 390; narrative and metrics remain legible.
visual_director.risk: The favorable regional total could distract from the below-target South; headline and risk text state the gap.

visual_director.person: Fab process engineer coordinating Quality and Equipment Engineering
visual_director.decision: Contain lot L2407 until chamber A verification and paired reference confirm recovery.
visual_director.truth: Affected yield is 94.2% vs 98.6% reference, with localized die loss; ETCH-08 chamber A pressure is +2.1%; 81-die wafer map, SPC time line and Reference/Affected box plot.
visual_director.negative_identity: Not a generic executive status deck; spatial signature and process sequence are central.
visual_director.density: High; wafer map, image crop, SPC, distribution, evidence table, finding and corrective action.
visual_director.salience: Containment headline; process-flow/evidence; wafer map and measured comparisons; corrective action.
visual_director.typography: Investigation statement; brief scope; section rails; chart/table labels; status/evidence card text.
visual_director.spacing: Engineering evidence grouped above analysis; action and KPIs separated into later sections.
visual_director.surfaces: Bounded engineering evidence and callout surfaces; wafer content clipped within its spatial boundary.
visual_director.feature_support: Wafer map and SPC/distribution are feature evidence; cropped image duplicates the same die data and is support.
visual_director.color: Blue/orange wafer scale carries measurement direction; red risk statement; green verified status.
visual_director.data_density: 81 die marks plus 4 time observations and 3 ledger rows.
visual_director.responsive: 390 and 320 recompose to ordered single column; flow is semantically stacked; table exposes horizontal scroll.
visual_director.risk: A reader may treat the image crop as independent evidence; its caption says it is the same measurements. Report image has no reader zoom/pan/fit controls.

visual_director.person: Growth experimentation lead and quality partner
visual_director.decision: Stage a limited treatment rollout while keeping the agreed quality guardrail and long-term-retention uncertainty explicit.
visual_director.truth: Treatment conversion moves 8.2% to 9.8%; control 8.0% to 8.5%; three cohorts remain inside the guardrail; four weeks do not establish long-term retention.
visual_director.character: Paired-cohort analytical narrative with explicit limits.
visual_director.density: High but grouped: two-series weekly chart, cohort box plot, evidence table, interpretation and recommendation.
visual_director.salience: Caveated conclusion; paired weekly trend; cohort distribution; denominator/guardrail table; rollout scope.
visual_director.typography: Statement, context, explanatory paragraph, compact cohort table, chart labels, recommendation and KPIs.
visual_director.spacing: Trend and interpretation sit as a feature/support pair; distribution follows; table supplies cohort facts; recommendation closes.
visual_director.surfaces: Separate table, recommendation and KPI surfaces; charts sit in analytical space.
visual_director.feature_support: Line trend leads; distribution tests spread; table grounds sample sizes and guardrail.
visual_director.color: Distinct blue and red/green series; semantic recommendation/status accents.
visual_director.data_density: Four time categories x two series; box distributions for both cohorts; three table rows.
visual_director.tone: Cautious inference, no causal certainty beyond sample.
visual_director.responsive: 390 one-column ordered reading with charts and table following narrative.
visual_director.risk: A reader could overstate treatment effect if missing the explicit four-week/retention limitation.

visual_director.decision: Keep the recipe locked until the paired-lot check closes two open items.
